best_practices: When an automated review suggestion contradicts a decision this plan already audited and recorded, decline the suggestion and cite the audit rather than reversing it. Documentation standards in this repo carry deliberate, recorded choices (format outliers kept for upstream-graft portability, verification obligations deliberately left local rather than CI-gated); a reviewer seeing only the file will read those as defects. Treat re-litigation of a settled decision as a standing consideration, not a finding.
